raw_text: Prefer simple, readable, composable code. Prefer clear names over generic names like Repository, Service, Manager, etc. Avoid using comments to overexplain everything. No code comments - use descriptive method/class names instead. User isolation enforced at database query level. When one of the applications is started for testing, make sure it's stopped once finished. dotnet watch run; dotnet run -p tests/BudgetTracker.Api.Tests --output detailed --filter-query "/path/to/test"; dotnet ef migrations add MigrationName; dotnet ef database update; npm run dev; npm run build; npm run lint; docker compose up -d; docker compose down.
